info.title: List
info.description: # Overview List Service manages various list types and list items for those list types across the entire suite of Huron Research Suite (HRS) V12 applications. Departments, Functions, Rights, and Roles are some examples of list types. The List Service API is implemented to offer the necessary tools to access and manipulate data related to simple Lists in HRS. It offers the following features. ### Features * Create, manage, export, and import simple lists from one environment to another. * Provide locking to prevent contention between multiple callers. * Complete many tasks by learning only one set of data management tools for your implementation. * Mutually exclusive security rights for jobs. ### Rights & Roles * Any authorized login user has read access to the list data. * The security rights are mutually exclusive which means the user has one right to one job only. For example, If the user has Manage list type, the user has permissions only to create and edit list types. ### List Permissions You will encounter lists that are configured with a few different permission models.

Sort.name: sort
Sort.description:
The field name to sort the items. The default sort order is descending.

To specify ascending sort order, prefix the field name with a dash (_e.g._ \"-dateModified\").  

You can sort by multiple fields by including multiple instances of this query parameter, in the sequence in which you want the sorting applied.

Filter.name: filter
Filter.description:
Filter, in the format:

filter[`fieldname`]=`comparisonOperator`:`value`      

* `fieldName`—filterable field name for one of the following `active`, `name`, `hrsowned`, `id` ,`defaultItemPermissions.fullAccess`, `moduleid`
* `comparisonOperator`—one of the following (as applicable to the data type of `fieldName`):
  * **eq**—Equal to
  * **neq**—Not equal
  * **lt**—Less than 
  * **lte**—Less than or equal to
  * **gte**—Greater than or equal to
  * **null**—Is null
  * **in**—In matches any value in the specified list
* `value`—The value to compare

To add multiple filters, include multiple instances of this query parameter, optionally preceded by a filterType=`logicalOperator` parameter:

* `logicalOperator`—one of the following:
  * **or**—Or
  * **and**—And

DefaultItemPermissions.description: An object containing the permissions that are assigned to List Items on the List.

fullAccess.description: Indicates whether the user has full access to create, edit, and delete any item. The values are true or false. When true, users with capability List-Full-Access are allowed to create, edit, and delete any item.

editLockedItemAttributes.description: User with capability List-Edit-Locked-Item is allowed to edit specified fields.

deleteUnlockedItem.description: Indicates whether the user is allowed to delete an Unlocked item. The values are true or false. When true, users with capability List-Delete-Unlocked-Item are allowed to delete an item.

createUnlockedItem.description: Indicates whether the user is allowed to create an Unlocked item. The values are true or false. When true, users with capability List-Create-Item are allowed to create new items.

**Note:** This may only be specified when creating a new List; otherwise, it is read-only.

tags.description: This API features Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) implemented in compliance with [W3C spec](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/). Implementation of this standard in the List service allows cross-domain communication from the browser. All responses have a wildcard same-origin which makes them completely public and accessible to everyone, including any code on any site.
